source.method: FigCli Yolo eval (read-only scripts); Light screenshots with verify

meta.naming: Find components by page + set name. Node ids and keys are not stored: they change in a duplicate. Two sets are named "Avatar" (legacy 60-variant set with Size Tiny..Large, newer 15-variant set with Size xsm..xl): pick by variant property names.
meta.group_mapping: Astryx pages -> our groups: Data Input + value controls (SegmentedControl, Chat composer parts) -> Form Elements; Action + Navigation pages, command palette and chat buttons -> Navigation; Container, Content, Feedback & Status, Layout, Overlay, Table & List and chat messages -> Data Display.
meta.contrast_check: contrast_fails = text layers under 4.5:1 (3:1 for 24px+) against their resolved background, computed from bound variables in Neutral Light and Neutral Dark (no screenshots of Dark: the file is read only and has no Dark preview frames). Text over images or scrims can be false positives.

components.name: Button
components.figma_description: XDS Button component with 4 variants (Primary, Secondary, Ghost, Destructive), 3 sizes (SM, MD, LG), interaction states, and icon-only mode. Toggle the Icon boolean to show a leading icon. Supports label text override.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.figma_description: Segmented button group for single selection with radio group semantics. Visually resembles a tab bar but controls a value, not a view. Supports text, icon + text, and icon-only content modes.

examples: Light Size=SM, State=Default, Content=Icon + Text "Week" Text/Secondary 4.20

components.name: SegmentedControl / SegmentedControlItem
components.figma_description: Individual segment item within a segmented control. Supports text, icon + text, and icon-only content modes with default, hover, selected, disabled, and focus states.

components.name: Button / ToggleButton
components.figma_description: A button that toggles between pressed and unpressed states. Ghost-style button with overlay-pressed background when active, semibold text emphasis, and icon swap support. Use for toolbar actions, view mode switches, and formatting controls. Works standalone or inside XDSToggleButtonGroup.

components.name: Toolbar
components.figma_description: Prop-driven Toolbar (overhaul). Content areas are native SLOTS (Start / Center / End) â€” drop Buttons, IconButtons, Dividers, SegmentedControls, etc. Bottom Divider is a boolean. VARIANT axes: Layout (Start + End | Start + Center + End), Density (Default | Compact), Variant (Transparent | Section | Wash). Replaces the deprecated 48-variant matrix.

components.name: Card
components.figma_description: A card container with border and themed styling. Use the Padding property to control internal spacing. The Content slot accepts any content.

components.name: Markdown
components.figma_description: Renders a markdown string as XDS-styled components. Supports headings, paragraphs, bold/italic, inline code, code blocks, blockquotes, lists, tables, links, and horizontal rules. Use for AI responses, documentation, and user-generated content.

components.name: Text
components.figma_description: Semantic text component. Renders text with type-based styling from the theme. Supports 8 text types, 5 color options, and truncation. Use type="body" for paragraphs, "label" for form labels, "supporting" for helper text, "code" for inline code, and "display-*" for hero headings.

components.name: Timestamp
components.figma_description: Displays formatted timestamps. Supports relative, absolute, and system formats with configurable color.

components.name: Blockquote
components.figma_description: A styled quotation (<blockquote>) with a left accent rule and optional attribution. Content slot holds the quote; toggle "Has Cite" to show the citation footer.

components.name: Slider
components.figma_description: Slider â€” a draggable control for selecting a numeric value or range. Track rail (Effects/Track) + filled portion (Core/Accent) + thumb. Wrapped in the Field pattern (label, description, status). Variants: state (rest/hover/focus/disabled/error/warning/success) x type (single/range). Toggles: Show Marks (ticks), Show Value (tooltip bubble), Show Description. Maps to packages/core/src/Slider.

components.name: DateRangeInput
components.figma_description: DateRangeInput â€” a startâ€“end date range field. Trigger shows the formatted range (e.g. "Jul 1 â€“ Jul 15") or the placeholder "Select date range", with a trailing calendar icon that opens a dual-month calendar popover. Variants: state (rest/focused/hover/error/warning/success/loading/disabled) أ— size (sm/md/lg). Built on Field + FieldLabel, mirroring DateInput.

components.name: DateTimeInput
components.figma_description: DateTimeInput â€” combined date + time field under one label. Date field (calendar icon) + time field (clock icon) side by side. Mirrors DateInput/TimeInput anatomy. Variants: state (rest, focused, hover, error, warning, success, loading, disabled) x size (sm, md, lg).

components.name: InputGroup
components.figma_description: Groups an input with prefix/suffix addons in a visually connected container with shared border. Prefix and Suffix are slots â€” drop an InputGroupText or a Button; toggle with hasPrefix/hasSuffix. Mirrors TextInput field anatomy (label, description, states, sizes, status).

components.name: Badge
components.figma_description: XDS Badge â€” status indicator in pill or dot shape. 5 semantic variants (Neutral, Info, Success, Warning, Error). Pill shows label + optional icon; Dot is a minimal 8px circle.

components.name: Banner
components.figma_description: Persistent status notification for info, warning, error, or success messages. Supports optional description, dismissible behavior, collapsible content area, and end-area slot for action buttons.

components.name: Skeleton
components.figma_description: A placeholder shape that indicates content is loading. Renders a pulsing block with configurable width, height, and border radius. Use the Radius property to control corner rounding.

components.name: Navigation / .MobileNavToggle

components.name: Pagination
components.figma_description: Prop-driven pagination. VARIANT: Size (md/sm). SLOT: Pages â€” compose page-number Button instances (current page = Secondary variant), ellipsis, first/last. BOOLEAN: Has Prev / Has Next gate the prev/next chevron buttons; Show Page Size Selector reveals the page-size Selector. Prev/Next use real Ghost icon-only Buttons with Lucide chevron-left/right.

components.name: Navigation / .SideNavItem
components.figma_description: Navigation item for XDSSideNav. Supports icon, selected state, end content.

components.name: Tabs / TabList
components.figma_description: Tab navigation wrapper. Provides size context to XDSTab children. Optional bottom divider. Default size is md.

components.name: Tabs / .Tab
components.figma_description: Tab item component. Renders inside XDSTabList. Selected state shows primary text with semibold weight and a bottom indicator bar. Uses textSecondary for default state.

components.name: Navigation / .SideNavSection

components.name: Navigation / TopNav
components.figma_description: Slot-based top navigation bar (maps to packages/core TopNav.tsx). Fill Heading, Start Content, Center Content, End Content. Toggle 'Has Center Content' for the centered 3-section layout (code centerContent -> 1fr auto 1fr grid). End Content is pushed to the right edge.

components.name: Overlay
components.figma_description:
Overlay â€” renders `content` on top of base media (image/card/video) with a scrim. Base slot = base content; Overlay Content slot = content shown over the scrim.

Variants:
â€¢ Scrim: dark (Core/Overlay token) | light (light translucent) | none (transparent)
â€¢ Align: start (top-left) | center | end (top-right) â€” matches CSS flex mapping for position=fill.

Defaults: scrim=dark, align=end, position=fi

components.name: OverflowList
components.figma_description:
A horizontal list that hides items that don't fit and shows an overflow indicator. Items that overflow are collapsed from either end. The overflow indicator (e.g. "+3 more") appears when items don't fit.

Props: children, gap (SpacingStep, default 2), collapseFrom (start|end), minVisibleItems, behavior (observeSelf|observeParent), overflowRenderer

components.name: Item
components.figma_description: Generic row/list-item layout primitive: [Marker] [Start Content] [Label + Description] [End Content]. Density controls block padding (Compact/Balanced/Spacious); Align controls vertical alignment of leading/trailing content. Slots: Marker, Start Content, End Content. Gated by Has Marker/Start Content/Description/End Content. Basis for List and MetadataList rows.

icons.naming: icon/<lucide-name> (kebab case), standalone components on the Icons page
icons.wrapper: Icon component set (Size xsm 12, sm 16, md 20, lg 24) with a nested icon instance to swap

slots_rule: Astryx uses native Figma SLOT properties for content areas (Content, Start/End Content, Footer, Body...). Place DS components inside slots; never draw content. "Has X" booleans gate each slot.
